issues.issue: Was an oral hearing required under s. 167 IRPR because the Officer implicitly made credibility findings?
issues.applicant_position: The Officer implicitly made adverse credibility findings, so an oral hearing was required under s. 167 IRPR.
issues.respondent_position: No credibility findings were made; the Officer only weighed the evidence, so no oral hearing was needed.
issues.result_quote: I agree with the respondent that an oral hearing was not required.

issues.issue: Did the Officer unreasonably assess personalized risk, ignoring evidence or analysing country conditions selectively?
issues.applicant_position: Officer ignored relevant evidence and gave insufficient reasons on personalized risk; country conditions were analysed selectively.
issues.respondent_position: Officer considered all relevant evidence and gave sufficient reasons; applicant offered insufficient evidence of personalized risk.
issues.result_quote: The Officer could very well accept that the evictions occurred, and yet still reject the fact the applicant was personally targeted.

issues.issue: Did the Officer reasonably find that state protection was available and the presumption of protection was not rebutted?
issues.applicant_position: The Officer's finding that adequate state protection was available is speculative and not supported by the evidence on record.
issues.respondent_position: Officer considered the evidence and reasonably found the applicant had not rebutted the presumption of state protection.
issues.result_quote: the Officer could reasonably conclude that the applicant did not rebut the presumption of adequate state protection in Hungary
